user.title: Connect Sendblue
user.description: Enter your Sendblue API credentials (`sendblue show-keys` or the dashboard) and the public HTTPS address Sendblue uses to reach Home Assistant.

data_description.webhook_base_url: For example your Nabu Casa remote URL or your own domain. Incoming messages are delivered to this address.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Sendblue
reauth_confirm.description: Sendblue rejected the stored credentials. Enter a valid API key.

error.no_lines: This Sendblue account has no phone line yet.
error.invalid_url: Enter an address that starts with https://.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

line_changed.title: Sendblue shared number changed
line_changed.description: Your Sendblue line is now {number}. Each recipient must text this number once before they can receive messages again.

webhook_registration_failed.title: Sendblue cannot deliver incoming messages
webhook_registration_failed.description: Registering the webhook with Sendblue failed. Sending still works, but replies and Assist will not until the integration is reloaded successfully.

data_description.conversation_agent_id: Agent that answers messages from recipients with Assist enabled.
